submission.justification: The project documents give no GWP100 values for any candidate, so I could not verify the hard GWP ≤ 150 limit. G1 is described as based on newer replacement gases, so it is the most likely to meet the limit. G3 is the standard fluorinated mixture and is very likely over the limit. G2 only partly substitutes the fluorinated component, so it probably exceeds the limit too. G3 and G2 would give better time resolution, about 0.9 ns and 1.3 ns at 2 mm, but I excluded them as probable GWP violations. For G1 I simulated gaps of 1, 1.6, 2, 2.4 and 3 mm. The time resolution was 2.35, 2.08, 1.87, 2.04 and 2.30 ns, so 2 mm is best. The GWP of G1 must be confirmed with the suppliers before this choice is final.

requirements.evidence: Among the mixtures I could plausibly accept, G1 has its best simulated time resolution at 2 mm, 1.871 ns. G1 is the slowest candidate overall. G2 and G3 are faster but are probably non-compliant on GWP.

requirements.requirement: Mixture is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: No document gives GWP values. G1 is described only as using newer replacement gases, so compliance is assumed but not verified.
